note: Allowed Incapsula page (HTTP 200) that ALSO carries the client-side SENSOR script <script src=/_Incapsula_Resource?SWJIYLWA=...> that Imperva injects into EVERY protected page for fingerprinting. visid_incap cookie + X-CDN:Incapsula vendor present, '_Incapsula_Resource' substring present, but NO block-only text ('Request unsuccessful' / 'Incapsula incident ID') and NO iframe incident_id= param. The same sensor-on-allowed-pages trap DataDome had: keying on the bare '_Incapsula_Resource' substring WRONGLY flags this CHALLENGE. Must NOT fire. Sources: Imperva sensor docs, capmonster.cloud Incapsula, chromedp #561, scrapingant.
